PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (22.0, 12.0, 26.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion: noise, gm efficiency)
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),        # input pair L (gain, flicker area)
    "itail": (2.4e-6, 1.2e-6, 4e-6), # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror / output device gm/Id
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # PMOS L (mirror + output CS, same density -> no syst. offset)
    "gmidn": (15.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # NMOS bias/tail/sink gm/Id
    "Ln":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),        # NMOS bias/tail/sink L
    "i7":    (6e-6, 3.5e-6, 8e-6),   # second-stage current
    "gbw":   (1.25e6, 0.95e6, 2.5e6),# GBW design target -> sets Cc
    "kz":    (2.0, 0.5, 5.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7 (LHP zero when kz>1)
    "vdst":  (0.15, 0.10, 0.25),     # Vds of bottom tail device under cascode
    "gmidc": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # tail cascode gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8); vcm = spec.get("vcm", vdd / 2)
    it = p["itail"]; i1 = it / 2; i7 = p["i7"]
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15

    # --- bias: ibias -> Rb -> diode MB (nb). Vcas = V(ibias) = Vgs_MB + Iref*Rb
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.5)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=max(mb.vgs, 0.2))

    # --- PMOS mirror load (diode) -> first-stage output DC level
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=max(m3.vgs, 0.3))
    vx = vdd - m3.vgs

    # --- input pair with body effect (bulk = vss), fixed-point on tail node
    vs = 0.3
    for _ in range(5):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(vx - vs, 0.1), vsb=max(vs, 0.0))
        vs = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.05)

    # --- cascoded tail: MT (Vds=vdst) + MC
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], it, vds=p["vdst"])
    vdc = max(vs - p["vdst"], 0.05)
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], 1.0, it, vds=vdc, vsb=p["vdst"])
    vcas = p["vdst"] + mc.vgs
    rb = max((vcas - mb.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    # --- second stage: PMOS CS (same density as M3) + NMOS sink mirrored from MB
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i7, vds=0.9)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1 = m1.gm; gm7 = m7.gm; gm3 = m3.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["gbw"])
    rz = p["kz"] / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("RB", "ibias", "nb", rb)
    n.dev("MB", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "nt", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MC", "tail", "ibias", "nt", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "nz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", cc)

    # --- predictions
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    a0 = a1 * a2
    rss = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs + mc.gds) / (mc.gds * mt.gds)
    cmrr = a1 * 2 * gm3 * rss
    psrr = a0 * (m7.gds + m8.gds) / m7.gds

    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    w = 2 * PI * p["gbw"]
    p2 = gm7 * cc / (C1 * C2 + cc * (C1 + C2))
    p3 = 1.0 / (rz * C1)
    pmir = gm3 / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    ph = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(w / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(w / p3)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(w / pmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(w / (2 * pmir)))
    if rz > 1 / gm7:
        z = 1.0 / (cc * (rz - 1 / gm7)); ph += math.degrees(math.atan(w / z))
    else:
        z = 1.0 / (cc * max(1 / gm7 - rz, 1e-3)); ph -= math.degrees(math.atan(w / z))

    # noise: thermal (pair + mirror) + rough flicker (Kn~1e-10, Kp~3e-11 V^2 um^2 Hz)
    th = 2 * 4 * kT * 0.75 / gm1 * (1 + gm3 / gm1)
    fl = 2 * (1e-10 / (m1.W * m1.L * 1e3)) + 2 * (3e-11 / (m3.W * m3.L * 1e3)) * (gm3 / gm1) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(th + fl)

    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": gm1 / (2 * PI * cc), "pm": ph,
               "power": power, "cmrr_db": db(cmrr), "psrr_db": db(psrr),
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew, "noise_1k": noise}
